backup_dir.description: Directory where the backup files will be stored.

full_backup.description: Whether to perform a full backup or an incremental backup.

threads.description: Number of threads for parallel backup operations.

target_file.description: Destination file path for single-file backups (if target_file is specified).

compression.description: Compression type used for the backup stream (e.g., gzip, lz4, snappy).

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging or logging purposes.

user.description: MariaDB user account used for the backup operation.

password.description: Password for the MariaDB user account.
